item.content:encoded:
I like this a lot.

The Foundation is obviously a very difficult place to work at. MTF staff can be basically assumed to have PTSD, and researchers or even admin staff are very likely to be exposed to incredibly traumatic experiences too.

Substance abuse disorders must be rampant among Foundation employees. And where the hell can they go? It's not like they can show up at a regular AA meeting and talk about the monster that brain-raped them and eviscerated their spouse.

The Foundation is huge, and prides itself on pragmatism. It just makes sense that they would have their own support groups and substance abuse treatment programs. The Foundation must have thousands of employees - of course some of them start their own AA group.
